en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic building complex on a slope or rampart, likely part of a castle or palace. The long, multi-windowed building with steep rooflines stands above a wooded embankment. Below, a small decorative bridge crosses a ditch or stream, and two figures walk on a path in a landscaped park. Tree branches frame the upper edge of the image, enhancing a picturesque, romantic view.
